basic_info.description: Fabulous top-floor condominium in a 1930s classic Marina building. Beautifully remodeled throughout by KAG Designs, this flat marries modern finishes with elegant period details. The formal living room spans the width of the building and features curved floor-to-ceiling windows, a Juliet balcony, peaked ceiling, and wood-burning fireplace flanked by built-in cabinetry. Through a whimsical arched doorway is the formal dining room, delineated by a chic chandelier, and the gorgeous, skylit kitchen, equipped with deluxe stainless appliances and quartz countertops. 2 generous bedrooms showcase oversized, east-facing windows with treetop-outlooks. The serene primary bedroom includes a dressing area with custom closet and an ensuite bath with shower and whimsical tile flooring. A spacious second bathroom off the hallway is well-appointed with chic herringbone tile and a shower over tub. At the front of the home is a large foyer with 2 convenient closets. Move right in with in-unit laundry, custom window treatments and gleaming oak hardwood floors. This unit also includes roof rights, independent one-car parking in garage, and generous storage. Pet-friendly building with low HOAs in a wonderful location, close to the waterfront, Marina Green, and the shops and dining on Chestnut St.
